title: ParAnimator configuration
description: Describes one animation render using an Id source par entry, output library files, and animated parameter tracks.

parameter-catalogs.description: Parameter catalog JSON files used to validate and resolve track targets.

items.description: Catalog filename or path read by ParAnimator.

source.description: Source Id par entry used as the base frame state.

name.description: Source entry name inside the source par file.

output.description: Generated output locations and names for Id library files and batch script.

directory.description: Output directory containing generated par, map, image, and script files.

par.description: Generated par filename written under the output par directory.

parallel.description: Optional number of Id render commands to run in parallel.

video.description: Id video mode used for generated render commands.

num-frames.description: Number of animation frames to generate.

tracks.description: Animated parameter tracks applied to the source par entry.

items.description: One animated parameter target and its keyframes.

oneOf.description: Track that writes generated Id map files and emits colors=@filename.

track-format.description: Output value format used by a virtual track.

oneOf.description: Emit an Id at-file reference such as @colors-0001.map.

track-mode.description: Alternate evaluation mode for a track.

oneOf.description: Pulse-width modulation between two explicit discrete values.

value-track.description: Parameter track defined by keyed parameter values.

parameter.description: Catalog parameter key, fractal params key, or formula metadata key to animate.

keys.description: Exactly two keyframes defining the animated value segment.

value-keyframe.description: One keyed parameter value at an animation frame.

frame.description: Zero-based frame index for this key.

value.description: Parameter value text in the format required by the target metadata.

curve.description: Optional interpolation curve override ending at this key.

pwm-track.description: Discrete track that temporally dithers between two explicit values.

parameter.description: Catalog parameter key, fractal params key, or formula metadata key to animate.

mode.description: Selects pulse-width modulation for this track.

a.description: Discrete value emitted when the evaluated mix selects the first endpoint.

b.description: Discrete value emitted when the evaluated mix selects the second endpoint.

window.description: Number of frames in each PWM decision window.

keys.description: Exactly two keyframes defining the animated mix segment.

pwm-keyframe.description: One keyed PWM mix value at an animation frame.

frame.description: Zero-based frame index for this key.

mix.description: Fraction of the PWM window assigned to value b.

color-map-track.description: Track that copies selected source map files to generated frame map files.

parameter.description: Id parameter to receive the generated at-file map reference.

type.description: Selects color-map side-file generation for this track.

format.description: Format for the generated Id parameter value.

output.description: Generated map filename pattern written under the output map directory.

keys.description: Exactly two keyframes selecting source map files.

curve.description: Interpolation curve used between two keyframes.

oneOf.description: Geometric interpolation, currently used for magnification values.
Hold the source value until the destination key.
Step from the source value to the destination value at the destination key.
